_comment: ADDITIVE IONO LADDER, arm A2 (2026-08-03) - representation_sigma_tecu 5.0 -> 1.5.
WHY THE qz0 SUBSTRATE: identical reasoning to _ft63_pdfix_qz0_deg15.json - at qz=1e-4
the carried-DD walk IS q_z and swamps the representation term (P2/P3), so the additive
direction is only visible against the qz0 floor (mature steps 0.168/0.096/0.030, SF k=32
flat at 1.51).  Same caveat: qz0 FAILED P2's clock-QC gate (clk_std 4.86 -> 5.29), so it
is a DIAGNOSTIC substrate.  A win here is a lead, not a posture; it must be re-run on the
qz=1e-4 posture (control runs/pdfix_v3) before promotion.
THE ONE VARIABLE - AND IT IS NOT ONE MECHANISM.  This single config key sets TWO things
(GnssConfigTypes.hpp): (a) the per-LOS single-layer representativeness sigma on the
SH<->slant pin row, and (b) the STEADY-STATE sigma of the mech-B Gauss-Markov per-LOS
deviation channel (rep_error_tau_s = 900 on this lineage).  So 5.0 -> 1.5 tightens the
pin AND shrinks the deviation channel's asymptotic amplitude at the same time.  One key,
two mechanisms - record it that way, and if the arm moves, the mech-B-off control from
P3 is the disambiguator.
THIS IS THE UNTESTED DIRECTION.  P3 already ran the LOOSENING leg (sigma_rep 5 -> 50) and
measured a complete null.  Tightening is the untested half, and it runs straight at a
DOCUMENTED hazard: the field's own doxygen says the prior 'is an INFORMATIVE prior on the
slant states, not a tight constraint - too tight aliases unrepresentable small-scale TEC
into huge low-degree coefficients at global scale.'  The arm exists to find out whether
that hazard is real at 63 sta / degree 8, or whether the 5.0 default is simply loose.
GRADE (control = runs/pdfix_qz0):
1. THE HAZARD FIRST - the SH a00 band and the sh_health gate.  'Huge low-degree
coefficients' is a00 leaving its band.  If a00 blows up, the arm is answered and
nothing below matters.  Also count iono-deweight engagements: a too-tight pin makes
ordinary stations look hostile to the robust-z screen.
2. scripts/grade_dd_spillway.py - mature steps against the 0.168/0.096/0.030 floor and
the structure function.
3. CROSS-BAND RATIO - the same discriminator as A1.  Every arm so far sits at
1.263-1.265 vs the common-cycle 1.2833 signature.  Absorbing iono means MOVING this;
tightening steps without moving it means the residual is unchanged in kind.
4. scripts/chain_stability.py total_IF hr2 + clk_std vs the qz0 control.
5. scripts/parse_carry_psd.py - the PD gate must still pass.
6. Post-fit sigma0 (code and phase) - a tightened pin that the data cannot support
shows up as a raised sigma0 before it shows up anywhere else.
